details: Claude delivery snapshots the resolved session transcript version before pane injection.
A delivery is acknowledged only after the transcript size/mtime version advances and the latest Claude composer is explicitly observed empty.
Missing transcript proof, unchanged transcript state, capture failure, or an absent prompt cannot produce a delivered ledger event.
An unconfirmed attempt returns false and leaves the original bridge message pending for a later worker attempt.
Non-Claude tmux targets retain the prior send-and-ack path and do not invoke Claude transcript confirmation.
The fallback waits through the full eight-poll grace window before retrying a stranded composer.
Fallback is permitted only when the latest composer exactly matches the injected message's first-line header, including its unique bridge-message ID prefix.
The fallback appends one literal space and sends exactly one additional Enter, then requires confirmation again.
Readiness checks only the latest Claude prompt, so an older empty prompt cannot override a newer human draft.
An independent adversarial probe with a post-injection human draft returned false with one Enter, no space retry, and the ledger message still pending.
Immediate delivery and worker draining share an exclusive per-message claim file.
The claimant rechecks pending state before injection, preventing acknowledgement or submission after another path has completed delivery.
The immediate/worker race regression records exactly one Enter, one delivered event, and no pending copy.
Claude session identifiers are allowlisted to bounded alphanumeric, underscore, and hyphen tokens, rejecting traversal separators.
Direct and fallback transcript candidates must be non-symlink regular files.
Canonical transcript paths must remain contained under the canonical Claude projects directory.
Regression coverage rejects both a traversal-shaped session id and a transcript symlink to an external file.
Independent complete bridge suite passed 67/67.
bun run build passed.
git diff --check passed.

known_limitations: Live loop-47 control-path refresh and pane-ID/PID preservation are operational acceptance checks separate from this source-level evaluation.
Transcript version proof intentionally uses file size plus modification time rather than parsing or persisting transcript contents.
notes: PASS. Independent review initially found latest-prompt, post-injection human-draft, transcript-path, and missing-pane-proof gaps. Each was fixed and regression-covered before this verdict.
